pulse.text: **Quiet sweep** — no new models and no leaderboard changes in the last three hours; the board still reads **Claude Opus 4.8 #1** on the AA Index (v4.1) at **56**, GPT-5.5 at 55, Claude Sonnet 5 at 53, Gemini 3.1 Pro at 46. The live drift is in the odds: Polymarket's 'best model end of July' firmed to **Anthropic ~91%** (Google ~8%, OpenAI ~2%), up a few points from ~88% last sweep, while the **end-of-2026** version of that market still sits far looser at **Anthropic 67%** — the lead looks safe through July but contestable after. The freshest story is markets, not product: **chip stocks sold off** to open the month (the Magnificent 7 shed **$2.3T in June**) and CNBC reports **OpenAI floated a 5% U.S.-government stake** as it courts the White House. Both near-term catalysts stay on the clock and still gated — **Gemini 3.5 Pro's July GA (~94% by Jul 31)**, a Vertex-only preview, and **GPT-5.6's broad public release (~93%)**, still limited to ~20 vetted orgs. Worth watching next: whether Google ships Gemini 3.5 Pro broadly before month-end — the single likeliest thing to dent Anthropic's July lead.
